_comment: FALLBACK AND SEED. The site prefers benefit copy from the Stripe product's metadata (see scripts/sync-pricing.mjs); this file is what it falls back to when Stripe carries none, and what scripts/push-offer-to-stripe.mjs pushes UP to Stripe to seed it. Keep it in step with Stripe or it will quietly become the thing nobody is reading.

benefits.title: Private member channel
benefits.description: A members-only channel on Slack or Discord. Ask your question on a Tuesday instead of holding it until the next meetup, and get an answer from someone who has already been through the same step.
included: Ask questions between meetups and get answers from other international founders
Share introductions, referrals and the names of people who actually helped you
Open from anywhere: you do not have to be in Austin that month

benefits.title: Guides as they publish
benefits.description: A founder guide library is in progress, written from questions raised at IFN meetups in Austin. Members get first access when each guide is published — we do not sell a finished library today.
included: First access to guides as they publish, starting with the questions founders raise most
Topics in progress: U.S. banking and forming a U.S. company as a non-citizen
Topics in progress: hiring and paying across borders as a small, new company

benefits.title: Monthly office hours
benefits.description: One members-only call every month. Bring whatever you are working through and get a direct answer on your own situation.
included: One call every month, for members only
Held by the people who run IFN
Join from anywhere: the call is online
